effortLevels.name: high
effortLevels.description: Work where verification matters or edge cases are likely, such as fixing a bug in an existing codebase. The default on every model except Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 4.7

effortLevels.name: low
effortLevels.description: Quick exchanges where you review each result, such as brainstorming, a first sketch, or a small change like a rename

effortLevels.name: max
effortLevels.description: Hard problems you want Claude to work through without you, such as finding security vulnerabilities. `max` may show diminishing returns and is prone to overthinking, so test before adopting it broadly

effortLevels.name: medium
effortLevels.description: The default on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, where it fits day-to-day engineering work with a clear scope, such as implementing a new feature. On other models, reduces token usage for cost-sensitive work that can trade off some intelligence

effortLevels.name: ultracode
effortLevels.description: A Claude Code setting rather than a level: plans a [dynamic workflow](/docs/en/workflows) for each substantive task at any effort level

effortLevels.name: xhigh
effortLevels.description: Deeper reasoning at higher token spend. The default on Opus 4.7
